Multiverse Computing announced that all CompactifAI models are now optimized to run on Intel Xeon 6 processors, enhancing performance and scalability for AI workloads. The company highlighted the deployment as a significant step toward more efficient, high‑throughput AI computing on commercial CPU platforms. This update is part of Multiverse Computing’s broader effort to expand the accessibility of its AI technologies.
